encoding.fit_curve: wide pale line, admitted gamma range

display_floor.retained: isfinite(E) and E >= tau, drawn at E
display_floor.below: isfinite(E) and 0 <= E < tau, downward triangle at (t, tau), no line
display_floor.invalid: nonfinite or E < 0, not drawn, counted

source.interpretation: Coarse illustration; finite positive gamma is not the exact transport map.
source.attribution: GHS-POP R2023A, epoch 2020; Schiavina, Freire and MacManus, European Commission JRC (2023). Natural Earth is public domain.
source.changes: One-degree aggregation, mean-land-density ocean fill, 1% land floor, normalisation and geometric mapping.

schedule.interpolation: linear in mapped coordinates for cells, coastline and graticule vertices; gamma label log-linear with the same fraction

fill.field: nearest mapped cell centre, original population and land category
fill.metric: squared Euclidean distance in plane radians, dx*dx + dy*dy in float64
fill.lookup: all centres, including ocean; cKDTree k=2, both candidates rechecked exactly; near ties within relative 1e-12 resolved by brute force over all centres
fill.sampling: one sample at each map pixel centre, x = (j + 0.5) / width, y = 1 - (i + 0.5) / height of the rectangle; evaluated anew every frame
fill.pixel_coverage: none; no antialiasing, blur, smoothing or sharpening of the fill

palette.contrast_rule: lowest LUT entry with contrast >= 3.0 against background
